about: Community catalog for KytyPS5 Studio: metadata only (names, descriptions, links). Studio ships with no catalog, no forks and no patch files. Load this file yourself (Settings > Community).

forks.name: chenxiao07 · Performance builds
forks.author: chenxiao07
forks.description: The most starred community fork. Windows releases (v2026MMDD) come with its own launcher scripts and a shader precompile tool (precompile.cmd) that builds a shader cache once per game version. Its README describes performance patches on top of the upstream code.
forks.notes: Shader caches can take several GB and a full precompile can take hours.

forks.name: Jetsku · U59 shader and renderer fixes
forks.author: Jetsku
forks.description: Experimental KytyPS5 U59 line with merged shader and renderer fixes, published as Windows and Linux releases. Ships a preset file (u59-preset.json) with performance switches such as shader precompile and pipeline prefetch; Studio applies it automatically.

forks.name: Biggsy · Astro Bot + DLSS Frame Generation
forks.author: Biggsy
forks.description: Experimental build whose repository description matches the U59 line (merged shader and renderer fixes). Releases are named astrobot-dlss-intNN and are published as pre-releases, built for Astro Bot with DLSS frame generation. According to its author, recent builds add a speed fix for Astro's Playroom and resolution scaling options in the launcher, so fixed-resolution patches are no longer needed.
forks.notes: DLSS frame generation normally needs an NVIDIA RTX graphics card. Frame generation raises the displayed frame rate; it does not make the game itself run faster.

forks.name: Cozmaaa · UFC 5
forks.author: Cozmaaa
forks.description: Build focused on UFC 5 (release files are named cozma-ufc5). Community members describe it as reaching a locked 60 fps in that game. Small download of about 24 MB; new builds appear every few days.
forks.notes: The 60 fps claim comes from chat messages and was not verified here.

forks.name: TheCruZ · GTA
forks.author: TheCruZ
forks.description: KytyPS5 fork focused on making GTA work smoothly and on finding bugs to push back to the main repository. Numbered releases (v11, v12, v13) for Windows, Linux and macOS.

forks.name: mn3ema · Frank (Marvel's Wolverine)
forks.author: mn3ema
forks.description: Experimental build tuned for Marvel's Wolverine. The author promises no support. Three small releases (v0.1 to v0.3).

forks.name: pengui07 · NHL
forks.author: pengui07
forks.description: Fork on a branch called cold. The repository description is the generic KytyPS5 text; the name points to NHL. A single release (about 62 MB) is published.
forks.notes: Purpose inferred from the repository name.

forks.name: Coder787 · KytyPlus
forks.author: Coder787-source
forks.description: KytyPS5-based emulator with extra compatibility and HLE work. The author calls the changes experimental crash and boot-reach improvements, not a playability claim. Larger download (about 58 MB) with frequent versions (v4.8 to v5.0 within two days).

forks.name: Senaxx · Upstream builds
forks.author: Senaxx
forks.description: Builds named after upstream commits (for example KytyPS5-2026-10-24-9d8944c). Useful when you want a recent build of the original code published by someone else.

forks.name: BryanKAdams · BryKytyPS5
forks.author: BryanKAdams
forks.description: Bryan's emulator based on KytyPS5 and Kyty. The latest release is from 2026-10-04, so it has not followed recent changes.

forks.name: MILLYONYT · Demon's Souls
forks.author: MILLYONYT
forks.description: Demon's Souls fork with numbered builds (version2 to version4). The last build is from 2026-10-04.
forks.notes: The release zips are not named like the usual Windows builds; Studio looks inside for kyty_emulator.exe and reports an error if it is missing.

forks.name: Mahir2861 · Ghost of Yotei (AMD test)
forks.author: Mahir2861
forks.description: Test build of Ghost of Yotei for AMD graphics (RX 9060 XT). Work in progress, about 5 fps according to the author. A single test release from 2026-10-12.

patches.name: Astro Bot · non-RT, FPS unlock, fixed resolution, physics fixes
patches.author: Jahirex
patches.description: 26 switchable options in one file: a non-RT renderer path, gameplay timers decoupled from render FPS (smoothed delta time, optional exact 60/90/120/144 fps cap), fixed render resolution (1080p to 4K), 30 fps physics fixes (rope bridges, cloth and inflatables, jack-in-the-box pads), two Havok crash fixes, lower model detail and lower texture memory, real-speed videos and a skip-intro option. R1+X toggles the timing patches at runtime. The author marks it experimental and untested ('sin probar'); it was ported from game version 1.018 to 1.007. Source: patch-list thread.

patches.name: Astro's Playroom · delta time, no-RT GI, frame caps, resolution, 30 fps physics
patches.author: Jahirex
patches.description: 17 options: gameplay timers decoupled from render FPS with exact frame caps (30 to 144 fps), R1+X runtime toggle, ray-traced GI removed, fixed render resolution (1080p to 4K) and 30 fps physics fixes (slingshot band, rope bridges). The author describes the 26/10 update as fixing input delay, frame pacing and a collision. Marked experimental. Source: patch-list thread.

patches.name: Astro's Playroom · low-resolution options for weak GPUs
patches.author: teogorghin
patches.description: A modified resolution patch with two extra low settings (720p and 540p), made for an AMD integrated-GPU laptop. 8 options: disable GI probes and lighting shaders, and fixed resolutions from 540p to 4K (720p and GI off by default). Source: patch-list thread.

patches.game: God of War: Sons of Sparta
patches.name: God of War Sons of Sparta · 1080p instead of 4K
patches.author: cosmo
patches.description: Render scale 0.5, so the game renders at 1080p instead of 4K. A single option, on by default. Source: patch-list thread.

settings.label: Frame generation
settings.desc: Extra generated frames. DLSS-G needs an RTX 40/50 card and the Streamline files (see the fork's README); the AMD FSR option works on any GPU.

settings.label: Upscaling
settings.desc: Replaces the game's own anti-aliasing with DLSS (RTX) or FSR 3.1 (any GPU).

settings.label: Frame rate limit
settings.desc: With DLSS-G, holds the rendered frames to this rate so generated frames are evenly spaced. Pick one your PC holds. 0 = off.

settings.label: Smooth frame pacing
settings.desc: After a slow frame, skip a vblank instead of showing the next frames back to back.

settings.label: Video memory budget (MB)
settings.desc: Leaves video memory free for DLSS-G (helps on 16 GB cards at 4K).
